description: A room for the room generator. Every kept seed becomes a room that dungeons can use like an imported one.

connectors.description: The sides with a doorway (three blocks wide and high, in the middle of the side), each with a connector named realmforge:door, like the imported rooms'.
connectors.title: Connectors

features.description: pillars, alcoves (niches in the walls without a doorway), pit (a sunken middle one block deep), balcony (a deck along a wall without a doorway, reached by stairs), rubble.
features.title: Features

footprint.description: [x, z]: width (west to east) and depth (north to south), walls included, 5 to 16 blocks.
footprint.title: Footprint

height.description: Blocks from the bottom of the floor to the top of the ceiling, 5 to 16.
height.title: Height

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

kind.description: entrance; the hallways corridor (two opposite connectors), curve (two adjacent), t_junction (three), crossing (four) and dead_end (one); combat, treasure and arena (the boss's room).
kind.title: Kind

pools.description: The room pools its rooms join (e.g. realmforge:stone_vault).

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

pools.title: Pools

rejected_seeds.description: The seeds the gallery review rejected, so rf rooms candidates shows new ones.
rejected_seeds.title: Rejected Seeds

seeds.description: The seeds the gallery review kept, each a room: realmforge:rooms/generated/<id>/seed_<n>. rf rooms review writes them.
seeds.title: Seeds

theme.description: The theme it is built with: realmforge:<id> of content/room_themes/.
theme.title: Theme

weight.description: Weight of each of its rooms in their pools.
weight.title: Weight

title: RoomSpecDef
